h1: Golf Cart Rentals for On Top of The World
lead: Masters Golf Cars has been the trusted golf cart rental provider for On Top of The World (OTOW) residents since 1999. Whether your personal cart is in for service, you have guests visiting, or you need an extra cart for community events, we deliver premium rentals directly to your OTOW home.

Located just minutes away at 12885 S US Highway 441 in Belleview, we serve all OTOW neighborhoods including Candler Hills, Indigo East, Friendship Colony, Avalon, and the original OTOW community. Our carts are perfect for accessing the Recreation Center, The Ranch Fitness Center, Candler Hills Golf Club, and all community amenities.

Need extra carts for club activities, block parties, or special community events? We provide multi-cart rentals for OTOW clubs and resident organizations.
Snowbirds returning for the season? Rent a cart while your stored cart is being serviced, or enjoy Florida without the commitment of cart ownership.
